# Atlanta Comedy Directory

> Atlanta's comedy scene in one place: theaters and clubs, improv troupes, open mics, comedy classes, podcasts and festivals, inside and outside the Perimeter. Curated by Dynamic El Dorado, an Atlanta comedy arts incubator. 111 listings, last changed 2026-10-25.

Details change often: confirm dates and prices with the venue or organizer.

## Related

- [Live Comedy Guide](https://guide.dynamiceldorado.com/): what's on this weekend in Atlanta
- [Dynamic El Dorado](https://dynamiceldorado.com/): the incubator behind this directory
- [Suggest a listing](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdmeltLBWwirmeO_R6KCv9PdUNMEizfonqVJX2pDmcGjky0cQ/viewform)

## Shows

- [Best of Atlanta Comedy Showcase](https://laughingskulllounge.com/series/best-of-atlanta/): Inside the Perimeter | Thursday through Sunday Thu 8 · Fri 8 & 10:30 · Sat 5:30, 8 & 10:30 · Sun 7:30 PM · Laughing Skull Lounge, 878 Peachtree St NE · Midtown | $20 to $55, depending on the night and show | Local stand-up showcases at Laughing Skull Lounge, four nights a week.
- [Black Voices Unscripted](https://www.wholeworldtheatre.com/series/black-voices-unscripted/): Inside the Perimeter | Dates to be announced 10:00 PM · Whole World Improv Theatre, 1216 Spring St NW · Midtown | A late-night improv show at Whole World.
- [BlackGround](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Dates to be announced 8:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | Dad's Garage's Black improv ensemble, the spiritual successor to Dark Side of the Room. Its newer cohort performs as BlackGround NXT.
- [Comedy on the Square](https://www.alleystage.org/events/118706): Outside the Perimeter | Fridays & Saturdays 8:00 PM · The Alley Stage, 11 Anderson St SE · Marietta Square | Weekend comedy at the Alley Stage on Marietta Square. Listed Oct 23 through Dec 26.
- [Dentata](https://www.crowdwork.com/e/dentata-nov2026): Inside the Perimeter | Fri Nov 20 · 9:00 PM · React Theatre, 572 Edgewood Ave SE · Old Fourth Ward | $20, or $30 with TRAD | A clown and bouffon solo show by Julia VanderVeen, presented by Dynamic El Dorado. Contains nudity. 18+.
- [Direct Depozit](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/direct-depozit-presents-scared-money-improv-show-tickets-1998396153691): Inside the Perimeter | Metropolitan Studios, 1259 Metropolitan Ave SE, Atlanta | An improv comedy group that plays shows at Metropolitan Studios, including its Halloween-themed Scared Money Improv Show. Tickets are through Eventbrite.
- Don't Tell Comedy: Inside the Perimeter | Location revealed 8 AM the day of the show | A secret-location comedy show with four to six comics per night. You find out where it is the morning of.
- [Drunk High Sober](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/drunk-high-sober-comedy-tickets-1997148335433): Inside the Perimeter | Monthly · check Eventbrite for the next date 9:00 PM · Argosy, 470 Flat Shoals Ave SE · East Atlanta Village | $10 in advance, $15 day of | A monthly stand-up showcase from Group 129: six comics, two drunk, two high, two sober. The audience guesses who's who and picks a winner who takes home $100. 18+.
- [DrunkProv](https://www.alleystage.org/events/135345): Outside the Perimeter | Select Wednesdays · The Alley Stage, 11 Anderson St SE · Marietta Square | A monthly improv night at the Alley Stage. Check the venue calendar for dates.
- [Felt Street](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Saturdays 8:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | A Saturday-night show at Dad's Garage.
- [Funny Bus ATL](https://www.funnybus.net/atlanta): Inside the Perimeter | Departs near the Margaret Mitchell House, 945 Crescent Ave NE · Midtown | Hosted by Gary Sammons · From $40 | A comedy city tour on a bus, hosted by local comedians. BYOB.
- [Joy Deficit](https://redlightcafe.com/events/joy-deficit-monthly-live-performance-event-oct-26-2026): Inside the Perimeter | Monthly, Mon 7:30 PM · Red Light Café, 553-1 Amsterdam Ave NE · Virginia-Highland | No cover | A monthly live performance night for Chaotic Good, with a changing roster: live literature, slam poetry, puppetry, music and comedy. No cover, free parking, and tips for performers are welcome. Doors 7 PM.
- [Maestro](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Wednesdays 8:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | A Wednesday-night improv show at Dad's Garage.
- [Monster Show For Monsters](https://redlightcafe.com/events/monster-show-for-monsters-variety-show-nov-16-2026): Inside the Perimeter | Mon Nov 16 · 8:00 PM · Red Light Café, 553-1 Amsterdam Ave NE · Virginia-Highland | $15 advance, $20 at the door, $30 VIP | An alternate-reality variety show with music, comedy, burlesque, drag, storytelling and magic, all performed by monsters. Doors 7 PM. 18+.
- [MovieProv](https://www.alleystage.org/events/135348): Outside the Perimeter | Third Wednesdays 8:00 PM · The Alley Stage, 11 Anderson St SE · Marietta Square | Improvised films, created live on stage.
- [Narsty!](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Saturdays 10:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | A late-night Saturday show at Dad's Garage.
- [Prime Time](https://www.wholeworldtheatre.com/series/prime-time/): Inside the Perimeter | Sat Oct 31 · 10:00 PM · Whole World Improv Theatre, 1216 Spring St NW · Midtown | A late-night improv show at Whole World.
- Rotknee Presents Monday Night Comedy: Inside the Perimeter | Mondays 9:30 PM–midnight · Star Community Bar · Little Five Points | Free | A free Monday-night comedy show.
- [Sad Boys in Harpy Land](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/alex-tatarskys-sad-boys-in-harpy-land-tickets-2002387973331): Inside the Perimeter | Nov 28–29, Sat 7:30 PM · Vesper Theatre, 2823 Church St · East Point | An unhinged solo clown show by experimental clown artist Alex Tatarsky: sad clown meets demented cabaret in a falling-apart coming-of-age story. Presented by Motherlode Theater. Nov 28 and 29, $25. Under 16 only with a parent or guardian.
- [Safety Third Improv](https://www.safetythirdimprov.com): Outside the Perimeter | Third Fridays 8:00 PM · Aurora Cineplex, 5100 Commerce Pkwy · Roswell | An 18+ improv troupe playing a monthly show built from audience suggestions.

- [Scandal!](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Fri Oct 23 · 8:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | Dad's Garage's improvised soap opera, which runs in seasons.

Doors 8 PM. 18+.
- [The Classic Improv Show](https://www.wholeworldtheatre.com/series/the-classic-show/): Inside the Perimeter | Fridays & Saturdays 8:00 PM · Whole World Improv Theatre, 1216 Spring St NW · Midtown | The theater's signature improv show, built from audience suggestions.
- The Dynamic: Inside the Perimeter | React Theatre, 572 Edgewood Ave SE, Suite 116 · Old Fourth Ward | Independent improv team, formerly the Dynamic El Dorado house team.
- [The Tipsy Zone](https://thetipsyzone.com): Inside the Perimeter | First Fridays 8:00 PM · Red Light Café, 553-1 Amsterdam Ave NE · Virginia-Highland | $15 in advance, $20 at the door; a 2026 season pass is $60 | An 18+ improv troupe doing a Twilight Zone-style improvised show with a boozy twist.
- [Thursday Happy Hour](https://www.wholeworldtheatre.com/series/thursday-happy-hour/): Inside the Perimeter | Thursdays 8:00 PM · Whole World Improv Theatre, 1216 Spring St NW · Midtown | A Thursday-night improv show at Whole World.
- [TRAD](https://www.crowdwork.com/e/trad): Inside the Perimeter | Fri Nov 20 · 7:30 PM · React Theatre, 572 Edgewood Ave SE · Old Fourth Ward | $20, or $30 with DENTATA | A clown and bouffon solo show by Hannah Mitchell, presented by Dynamic El Dorado. 18+.
- [Y'all's Line is it Anyway?](https://www.alleystage.org/events/135346): Outside the Perimeter | First Wednesdays · The Alley Stage, 11 Anderson St SE · Marietta Square | A monthly improv night at the Alley Stage.
- [You're Invited!](https://www.dadsgarage.com/shows): Inside the Perimeter | Thursdays 8:00 PM · Dad's Garage, 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | A Thursday-night show at Dad's Garage.

## Education

- [Alliance Theatre: Adult Improv](https://www.alliancetheatre.org/education/class/improv-i): Inside the Perimeter | No sessions open right now · Alliance Theatre, 1280 Peachtree St NE · Midtown | $400 for 8 weeks of 3-hour sessions | Small adult improv classes at the Woodruff Arts Center.
- [Clown Rot](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/clown-rot-a-clown-workshop-with-alex-tatarsky-tickets-2003553560634): Inside the Perimeter | Sun Nov 29 · 12–4 PM · Vesper Theatre, 2823 Church St · East Point | $100 | A four-hour clown workshop with Alex Tatarsky, presented by Motherlode Theater. Move, play and write with your body, using failure, decay and falling apart as material. All experience levels.
- [Clowns of Steel](https://tellerproductions.com/clownsofsteel): Inside the Perimeter | Four Saturdays, Nov 21 – Dec 12 · 10 AM–2 PM · Teller Productions, 486 Park Ave SE · Grant Park | Hosted by Karie Vieira and Erica Acebo · $280, with a $30 early-bird discount for the first four sign-ups | A beginner clown course presented by Teller Productions and run by Nonesuch Theatre of Play (Karie Vieira and Erica Acebo). Covers the history and nature of clown, playing without a fixed plan, working with scene partners and audiences, and using failure as a tool.
- [Dad's Garage University](https://dads-garage.coursestorm.com/browse): Inside the Perimeter | Fall term: Saturdays and Sundays, Oct 10 to Nov 29 · 4:30 PM and 7:00 PM · Dad's Garage & React Theatre | Hosted by Ronnie Johnson-Lopez, Maged Roushdi, Ron Emile, Nate Brosy, Lila Mensing, Perry Frost · $280 for Level 1 to 3 improv and stand-up; $300 for sketch | Eight-week classes from Level 1 improv to performance labs, plus stand-up, sketch, burlesque and a 55+ improv track.
- [Dynamic El Dorado](https://dynamiceldorado.com): Inside the Perimeter | Visiting workshops, plus shows at partner venues across Atlanta | A comedy incubator that brings visiting instructors for clown, bouffon, improv, stand-up and sketch workshops, and produces shows at partner venues.
- [Jeff Justice's Comedy Workshoppe](https://comedyworkshoppe.com): Inside the Perimeter | Level I starts Jan 25, 2027 · The Punchline, 3652 Roswell Rd NE · Buckhead | Hosted by Mark Evans · $599 for Level I | Long-running Atlanta stand-up classes, Level I and II.
- [KOS Writers' Room](https://www.koscobb.org/): Outside the Perimeter | every other Monday 7:00 PM · KOS, 598 W Atlanta St SE, Suite A · Marietta | Hosted by Leah Marie | A writers' room every other Monday. Writers bring work in progress and build it with the group.
- [Sketchworks Comedy](https://www.sketchworkscomedy.com): Inside the Perimeter | Atlanta | A sketch comedy company offering sketch writing classes and one-on-one coaching.
- [Stage Door Theatre: Adult Improv](https://stagedoortheatrega.org/adult-improv-classes/): Outside the Perimeter | Sundays, Sep 13 to Nov 8 · 4:00 PM and 7:00 PM · Dunwoody Cultural Arts Center, 5339 Chamblee Dunwoody Rd · Dunwoody | Hosted by Avery Sharpe-Steele · $275 | Sunday adult improv classes at several levels.
- [Tom Patillo Classes](https://www.koscobb.org/): Outside the Perimeter | KOS, 598 W Atlanta St SE, Suite A · Marietta | Upcoming classes taught by Tom Patillo at KOS in Marietta.
- Writers Room at Joe's Coffee: Inside the Perimeter | Sundays 4–6 PM · Joe's Coffee, 510 Flat Shoals Ave SE · East Atlanta Village | Hosted by Matt Tyler | A weekly writers workshop.

## Festivals

- [All The Laughs Comedy Festival](https://filmfreeway.com/AllTheLaughsComedyAwards): dates vary · Atlanta | A comedy festival and awards program that takes submissions through FilmFreeway.
- [Atlanta Comedy Film Festival](https://filmfreeway.com/AtlantaComedyFilmFestival): Inside the Perimeter | January · 7 Stages, 1105 Euclid Ave NE · Little Five Points | Comedy shorts, features, sketch and stand-up films. The 2027 festival runs Jan 22–24.
- [Atlanta Fringe Festival](https://atlantafringe.org): Inside the Perimeter | Late May–June | An annual performance festival, with 2026's edition running May 27–June 7.
- [Laughing Skull Comedy Festival](https://www.laughingskulllounge.com): Inside the Perimeter | dates vary · Laughing Skull Lounge, 878 Peachtree St NE · Midtown | An annual stand-up festival from Laughing Skull Lounge, with local and touring comics across multiple shows. Check the lounge for the next dates.
- [West End Comedy Fest](https://www.westendcomedyfest.com): Inside the Perimeter | Mar 5-7, 2027 · Wild Heaven Garden Club, Wild Heaven Lounge and Plywood Place · West End | A neighborhood festival with 75+ comedians across West End venues.

## Podcasts

- [Amy Brown Comedy Podcast](https://amybrowncomedy.com/podcast): Podcast | A weekly comedy podcast hosted by Amy Brown, with a guest comic each episode.
- [Billy Willig's Billy Podcast](https://www.instagram.com/billypodcast/): Outside the Perimeter | Podcast | A podcast hosted by comedian Billy Willig.
- [Cheaties](https://search.podderapp.com/podcast/cheaties-with-lace-larrabee-and-katherine-blanford): Inside the Perimeter | Hosted by Lace Larrabee & Katherine Blanford | A comedy podcast hosted by Lace Larrabee and Katherine Blanford.
- [Hot Breath!](https://hotbreath.beehiiv.com): Outside the Perimeter | Host: Joel Byars | Joel Byars interviews comedians, from Atlanta favorites to national headliners. 400+ episodes.
- [Hot Comics (archive)](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/hot-comics/id1613648867): Inside the Perimeter | Hosts: Lisandra Vazquez & Brandi Unger · 2022–23 | Atlanta stand-ups chat with local comics, late-night-talk-show style.
- [The Tim Andrews Popcast](https://wsbradio.com/onair/popcast): Inside the Perimeter | 95.5 WSB | Conversations about Atlanta comedy, film, pop culture and the stage scene.
- [What's Good, Atlanta?](https://www.wabe.org/podcasts/whatsgoodatlanta/whats-good-atlanta/): Inside the Perimeter | WABE | A WABE public-radio podcast about Atlanta culture and the people shaping it.
- [Yes, And (archive)](https://yesandpod.podbean.com): Inside the Perimeter | Host: Rylee Cravens · 2023–24 | Interviews with Atlanta improvisers and comedians about taking risks on stage.

## Resources

- [AllImprov: Atlanta](https://allimprov.com/atlanta/): Online calendar | A running calendar of Atlanta improv shows, jams and classes.
- Atlanta Comedy Discord: Discord server | An online community for Atlanta comics and comedy fans: show announcements, open-mic chatter and collaborators.
- [Atlanta Comedy Discord Open Mic Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/embed?src=atlcomedydiscord@gmail.com&ctz=America/New_York): Google Calendar | A shared calendar of Atlanta open mics, kept by the Atlanta Comedy Discord community.
- [FlopBox: Atlanta](https://flopbox.net/city/atlanta): Online calendar | An alt-comedy and clown calendar, now with an Atlanta page.
- [Hey I'm Coming to Atlanta](https://www.facebook.com/groups/heyimcomingtoatlanta): Facebook group | A Facebook group where touring comics announce they're coming to Atlanta and look for local shows.
- [Live Comedy (cheap!)](https://squareup.com/customer-programs/enroll/tdb8t92f3zVq): Email from Dynamic El Dorado | Email from Dynamic El Dorado: hand-picked highlights of Atlanta's lesser-known live comedy. Free to join.

## Venues

- [7 Stages](https://www.7stages.org): Inside the Perimeter | 1105 Euclid Ave NE · Little Five Points | Experimental and international theater. It hosts the Atlanta Comedy Film Festival.
- [Atlanta Workshop Players · Studio 13](https://www.atlantaworkshopplayers.com): Outside the Perimeter | 1580 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Suite 13 · Roswell | Saturday-night improv in a blackbox, with adult and youth troupes.
- [Aurora Cineplex](https://linktr.ee/auroracineplex): Outside the Perimeter | 5100 Commerce Pkwy · Roswell | A movie theater that hosts monthly live improv, watched from heated recliners.
- [Bogg's Social & Supply](https://www.boggssocial.com/): Inside the Perimeter | West side, just off the Beltline | A social venue that has hosted comedy events. Check its calendar for upcoming shows.
- [Dad's Garage](https://www.dadsgarage.com): Inside the Perimeter | 569 Ezzard St SE · Old Fourth Ward | Atlanta's long-running improv theater: weekly improv, sketch and family shows, plus Dad's Garage University classes in improv, stand-up, sketch and burlesque.
- [Helium Comedy Club](https://atlanta.heliumcomedy.com): Outside the Perimeter | 3070 Windward Plaza · Alpharetta | Touring headliners in the main room, plus smaller shows "In The Other Room."
- [KOS](https://www.koscobb.org/): Outside the Perimeter | 598 W Atlanta St SE, Suite A · Marietta | A Cobb County learning community that hosts stand-up classes, Tom Patillo's classes and a writers' room every other Monday.
- [Laughing Skull Lounge](https://www.laughingskulllounge.com): Inside the Perimeter | 878 Peachtree St NE · Midtown | Dedicated stand-up room with weeknight open mics, weekend local showcases, and stand-up classes.
- [Metropolitan Studios](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/direct-depozit-presents-scared-money-improv-show-tickets-1998396153691): Inside the Perimeter | 1259 Metropolitan Ave SE, Atlanta | A studio space that hosts live improv, including Direct Depozit's Scared Money Improv Show. Doors open at 7:30 PM for 8 PM shows.
- [Onward Theatre](https://onwardtheatre.org): Inside the Perimeter | 711 Catherine St SW · Southwest Atlanta | Improv, stand-up and short-play nights, plus stand-up and musical improv classes.
- [React Theatre](https://www.dadsgarage.com/react-calendar): Inside the Perimeter | 572 Edgewood Ave SE, Suite 116 · Old Fourth Ward | Run by Dad's Garage. Student and indie improv shows, late-night jams, two open mics (Sunday afternoons and Wednesday nights), and visiting-artist events.
- [Red Light Café](https://redlightcafe.com/): Inside the Perimeter | 553-1 Amsterdam Ave NE · Virginia-Highland | Music and cabaret venue, home of Tease Tuesday Burlesque and The Tipsy Zone improv.
- [Relapse Comedy · Comedy City](https://relapsecomedy.com/Home): Inside the Perimeter | Atlanta | Relapse Theatre's Comedy City booking platform for showtime slots, with a Relapse University class program.
- [The Alley Stage](https://www.alleystage.org): Outside the Perimeter | 11 Anderson St SE · Marietta Square | Weekend comedy, a Tuesday open mic, monthly improv nights, and stand-up, improv and sketch classes.
- [The Punchline](https://www.punchline.com): Inside the Perimeter | 3652 Roswell Rd NE · Buckhead | Classic stand-up club with nightly shows. Also home to Jeff Justice's Comedy Workshoppe classes.
- [The Supermarket](https://www.thesupermarketatl.com/): Inside the Perimeter | 638 N Highland Ave NE · Poncey-Highland | A DIY arts venue on Atlanta's Eastside that hosts comedy and other live shows. Check its calendar for comedy nights.
- Tucker Brewing Company: Outside the Perimeter | 2003 S Bibb Dr · Tucker | A brewery that hosts occasional stand-up nights and comedy fundraisers.
- [Whiplash Comedy](https://www.whiplashcomedy.com/): Inside the Perimeter | 650 North Ave NE, Ste S201 · Ponce City Market · Old Fourth Ward | A comedy club above City Winery at Ponce City Market, opened October 12, 2026 by the former operator of Laughing Skull Lounge.
- [Whole World Improv Theatre](https://www.wholeworldtheatre.com): Inside the Perimeter | 1216 Spring St NW · Midtown | Short-form improv on Friday and Saturday nights, late shows, and 10-week improv classes.
